reasoning: A hybrid approach combines autonomous reasoning to identify high-level, intuitive differences between the instances with external XAI tools to quantitatively validate and measure feature contributions. tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP provides game-theoretic feature importance, enabling a contrastive view of how features affect outcomes. LIME offers interpretable local explanations for each instance. Integrated Gradients offer gradient-based attribution from baseline to instance, useful for detecting subtle shifts. Sensitivity analysis isolates feature impact by ablation, helping identify which features are decisive in classification, especially when instances are similar but predictions differ.
